events.comment: Shared combat rules. Runs before the Samurai events so they can react on the same frame.

Samurai death hold: his HP reached 0 on his last life without a posture break (Combat_Shared just set JustDied). Instead of dying at once, he kneels posture-broken at 0.01 HP with the deathblow orb, so the deathblow is what ends him. JustDied and JustLostLife are both cleared, or his sheet would start the death (or the intermission) now. Not during a deathblow: the deathblow kills him this same way, and that must stand.

Samurai death hold: no deathblow came before the stun ran out, so he dies on his own. HP 0 lets Combat_Shared take the last life next frame, and clearing JustRecovered stops his sheet from standing him up.

Samurai life hold: his HP reached 0 with a life to spare (phase 1). Combat_Shared already took the life (JustLostLife), which would start the petal intermission with no chance of a deathblow. Instead he gets the life back and kneels at 0.01 HP, posture-broken, with the orb. The deathblow takes the life, and then the intermission plays as usual.
Samurai life hold: no deathblow came before the stun ran out, so he loses the life anyway and the intermission starts. LifeHold 2 keeps the hold above from catching it again.
Samurai life hold: the life is gone (to the deathblow or the timeout), so the hold is over.
Scene start: play this scene's own music, Crimson Petals on Stone. Each scene starts its own track.
Ambient wind: the cherry blossoms on Samurai_BG sway slightly, and muted petals drift behind the fighters. Tune the values at the top of the code.

inlineCode: // Ambient wind: the cherry canopies sway slightly, and petals drift across the arena.
// Everything here is decoration on the Background layer, behind the fighters.
const SWAY_PIXELS = 2; // How far the canopies sway, in pixels. Keep it small.
const CANOPY_BOTTOM = 560; // Below this height (the trunks and meadow), nothing sways.
const PETAL_PIXEL = 2; // Size of one petal "pixel". Petals are 3x2 of these.
const WIND_SPEED = 55; // Average sideways drift, pixels per second. Negative blows left.
const FALL_SPEED = 30; // Average fall speed, pixels per second.
const PETAL_COLORS = [0xd99aae, 0xe8b8c6, 0xc98399]; // Muted pinks, to sit with the muted backdrop.
state = runtimeScene.__ambientWind = { time: 0, filter: null, petals: [], container: null, textures: [] };
// Canopy sway: a shader on the backdrop that nudges pink (blossom) pixels back and forth.
"precision highp float; // Must match the default vertex shader.",
"  vec4 c = texture2D(uSampler, clamp(uv, inputClamp.xy, inputClamp.zw));",
"  return smoothstep(0.10, 0.25, c.r - c.g) * step(0.35, c.r);",
"  offset.x = 0.7 * sin(uTime * 0.9 + pos.y * 0.012 + pos.x * 0.004) + 0.3 * sin(uTime * 2.3 + pos.x * 0.03 + pos.y * 0.02);",
"  gl_FragColor = texture2D(uSampler, clamp(vTextureCoord + offset * w * inputSize.zw, inputClamp.xy, inputClamp.zw));",
state.filter = new PIXI.Filter(undefined, fragment, { uTime: 0, uSway: SWAY_PIXELS, uBottom: CANOPY_BOTTOM });
// Keep the sway first, so the backdrop's Mute and Soften effects apply on top of it.
// Petals: small pixel petals drawn between the backdrop and the floor strip.
state.container.zIndex = 1.5; // Backdrop is z 1, the floor strip is z 7.
const texture = renderer.generateTexture(shape, { scaleMode: PIXI.SCALE_MODES.NEAREST, resolution: 1 });
// New petals come off a canopy or blow in from the upwind edge.
if (petal.y > FLOOR_Y || petal.x > 1300 || petal.x < -20) spawnPetal(petal, false);
// Flutter by flipping, not rotating, so the pixels stay square.

events.comment: The Samurai, from the shared Samurai_Boss sheet.

Samurai holds: while he kneels at 0 HP (either hold), plain hits cannot land, or one would take the life without a deathblow (the deathblow ignores Invulnerable). His stun stands him up after KneelHold, before the stun ends, so the kneel timer is held at zero to keep him down. After his sheet's events, which clear Invulnerable during a stun.
Samurai life hold: the same, for the phase 1 hold.

Samurai death hold: his sheet starts Samurai_Death from frame 0 (standing), but he is already kneeling: carry on from frame 7, its settled kneel, so he does not pop up and kneel again. The hidden petal ending, further down, still takes over when it was earned.

Fight start: the Samurai kneels in prayer (his death animation held on frame 4: seated, hands in his lap, sword laid beside him) for KneelTime seconds, then rises and bows before the duel. AIStates Kneel, Rise and Bow are unknown to the Samurai_Boss sheet, so it leaves him alone. The player is free to move; attacking him during any of it is dishonorable (see the last opening event). OpeningStep is 1 for the whole opening and 0 once the fight is on.
Opening clock: OpeningT counts the seconds since the current opening step (kneel, rise) started.
Prayer over: start to rise.
Rising: his death frames 4 to 0 played backwards, one every RiseFrameTime seconds, so he takes up his sword and stands.
Standing: bow to the player (1.4 s: the bow, then a short pause upright).
Bow finished (1.4 s: the bow, then a short pause upright): he engages at once. The bow is the intro, so there is no extra opening wait (IdleTimer 0).

Dishonor: the player attacked him during the kneel, the rise or the bow. A hit shows as lost HP or gained posture; his opening dodge or a stagger shows as the Samurai_Boss sheet moving him out of the opening states. He skips straight to his aggressive phase 2 moveset (Phase 2, running at RunSpeed), the same switch his intermission makes. His HP and lives are unchanged, so the intermission and the ultimate still come on his last life. Dishonored stays true for the rest of the fight.
Struck while still in the opening (no dodge or stagger took over): come straight at the player.
Hidden ending: track the hits the player takes, to decide whether the Samurai's unique death is earned (no hit in the whole fight, or no hit from his Thousand Cuts).

inlineCode: // Hidden ending: the Samurai's unique death is earned by beating him without taking a single hit in the whole fight,
// OR without taking a single hit from his Thousand Cuts ultimate (at least one cast seen). A hit is any drop in the
// player's Health (healing only ever raises it), so grabs, petals, cuts and slashes all count.
// The verdict is kept in Samurai_NPC.HiddenEndingEarned and freezes once he is dead.
const st = runtimeScene.__noHit || (runtimeScene.__noHit = { last: null, hits: 0, ultHits: 0, ultSeen: false });
if (st.last !== null && health < st.last - 0.0001) { st.hits++; if (inUlt) st.ultHits++; }

events.comment: Hidden ending: earned, so when the Samurai_Boss sheet starts his death (DeathStep 1), play the hidden petal ending instead: he kneels, dissolves into petals, and leaves his sword standing. DeathStep 20 keeps the sheet's seppuku holds out of it, and physics stay off for the taller frames. Combat_Shared returns to the hub once it reaches its last frame.
